name: square flask bottle
caption: A square flask bottle with a flat body, a short neck and a sealed base. A sealed base carries four flat walls; a stepped shoulder narrows to a neck. Faceted walls keep a constant thickness along the straight body. Overall width is 1.25 times depth; height is 0.75 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous dark brown, tan, cream color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
